battery_grade_matrix.gauge_sentence: At fixed grade, thinner foil lowers the bite-free thresholds except where the proposed strength steps up between bands (high-strength critical ridge height rises from 15 to 13 um because the proposal steps from 1100 220 to 1100 250 MPa between the bands): standard grade, 20 -> 10 um: critical ridge height 0.118 -> 0.0506 um, trough onset magnitude 23.6 -> 11.1 kPa, roller-wrinkle threshold magnitude 6.85 -> 3.43 MPa; on credible bites only (20, 18 um) the in-mill stripe onset height goes 21.8 -> 29.9 um from 20 to 18 um (bite-dependent results excluded at 15 um, 13 um, 12 um, 10 um: not credible or no bite); high-strength grade, 20 -> 10 um: critical ridge height 0.125 -> 0.0766 um, trough onset magnitude 24.1 -> 13.2 kPa, roller-wrinkle threshold magnitude 6.85 -> 3.43 MPa; fewer than two credible bites, so no bite-dependent gauge trend (bite-dependent results excluded at 18 um, 15 um, 13 um, 12 um, 10 um: not credible or no bite).
battery_grade_matrix.grade_sentence: At fixed gauge, the high-strength proposal instead of the standard one: 20 um 1235 210 -> 1100 220 MPa (Rm +5 %, ridge +6 %, trough +2 %, in-mill stripe onset +20 %); 18 um 1235 210 -> 1100 220 MPa (Rm +5 %, ridge +6 %, trough +2 %); 15 um 1235 185 -> 1100 220 MPa (Rm +19 %, ridge +23 %, trough +9 %); 13 um 1235 180 -> 1100 250 MPa (Rm +39 %, ridge +48 %, trough +18 %); 12 um 1235 180 -> 1100 250 MPa (Rm +39 %, ridge +48 %, trough +18 %); 10 um 1070 185 -> 1100 262 MPa (Rm +42 %, ridge +51 %, trough +19 %). Ridge height follows the proof strength and the trough and roller-wrinkle thresholds follow the tensions, set as fixed fractions of the flow stress in this survey; bite-dependent changes are given only where both bites are credible (20 um). Evidence WEAK (fallback rule: no usual choice of that grade is published for the band, so the option with the highest standard minimum is used): the high-strength proposal at 20 um (1100); the high-strength proposal at 18 um (1100); the standard proposal at 10 um (1070). These rows are less supported than those where the research names a usual choice.
battery_grade_matrix.mill: battery-foil demo mill (single-stand four-high foil mill, synthetic)
battery_grade_matrix.note: Literature strengths (proposals to confirm with the plant) on a synthetic mill; model sensitivities, not plant defect rates.
battery_grade_matrix.ridge_strength_basis: critical ridge height computed with the proposal's proof strength Rp0.2 as the yield stress of the wound foil (the coil-ridge criterion is a yield criterion; Rp0.2 is published only for some grades, otherwise assumed from the median Rp0.2/Rm ratio, see band_products.proposed_material); the main survey table uses the flow stress there, kept here as critical_ridge_height_at_flow_stress_m for comparison
battery_grade_matrix.rules: final pass: the plant route where the gauge matches (18 and 12 um), else the nearest published single-sheet pass of the product; tensions, friction and speed by the survey rules; a bite outside the reported battery-foil force range is NOT CREDIBLE and excluded from every bite-dependent comparison and sentence

limitations: Synthetic: one stated mill per gauge class (the demo mills), not any plant; the products differ in gauge, flow stress, tension and speed only.
Inputs are literature values from the product catalogue (a survey of excerpts, patents, standards previews and vendor or trade pages); each row carries the read status.
Assumed values are labelled per row (flow stress without a published as-rolled strength, reduction without a published span, the tension fractions, friction 0.03, the mill).
Doubled (pack-rolled) final passes are not modelled: no bite, only per-sheet bite-free thresholds.

Roll bites below about 60 um come from the experimental mattress model (order of magnitude); below 20 um exit gauge or above 50 % reduction from its unvalidated extended domain. The force range used for the credibility mark is reported for battery-foil passes only.
Chatter numbers are open-gap linear screening values; above the span-wave limit they are flagged not reliable.
Nothing here is validated against plant data; rankings compare model sensitivities on a synthetic mill, not plant defect rates.
Literature survey only: every value is quoted from three research reports, not measured.
No plant validation: a value inside a published span is not evidence that a pass is good.
Vendor and trade pages are low-confidence; several standards were read from previews only.
Finished-product tensile strength is not the rolling flow stress; that comparison is an indicator only.
Spans mix minima, typical values and ranges from different sources; read the basis.

Doubled (pack) rolling gives one-side-bright foil: UACJ sells 10 µm 8021 as bright/matte and the BF-S17 schedules finish with a doubled pass. summary: 27 catalogue products, one synthetic final pass each: 22 with a roll bite, 5 doubled (bite not modelled), 1 with a bite marked not credible, 19 with an assumed flow stress. Coil ridges (critical ridge height at the outer coil radius): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +0.99). Troughs and creases in the exit span (trough onset lateral stress, magnitude): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +1.00). Roller wrinkles on the deflector roll (threshold magnitude): most sensitive cigarette_liner_foil (6.48 um), converter_foil (6.5 um), household_foil (10.5 um); the thinner the product, the more sensitive (rank correlation +1.00). Cooling stripes visible in the mill (in-mill onset height of a roll stripe): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), brazed_fin_stock (89.4 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.66); 6 excluded. Cooling stripes visible after tension release (after-release onset height, an upper bound where reporting-limited): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), container_foil_retortable (91.7 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.62); 6 excluded. Chatter margin (survey speed over the critical speed without bite damping): most sensitive container_foil_smooth_wall (134 um), litho_sheet (272 um), container_foil_retortable (91.7 um); no clear gauge order (rank correlation -0.28); 12 excluded. These are model sensitivities on one synthetic mill per gauge class with literature inputs, not plant defect rates.
